title: Normalized tensor augmentation commutes with reindexing
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $g:X\xrightarrow\sim Y$ an isomorphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the completed-ring derived categories and the recorded coefficient calculus [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Let $A,T$ be any normalized completion and completed-tensor reindexing data [def-pod-completion-reindex-models, def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization]. Let $c$ be any ordinary Hom/tensor comparison with its chain and derived normalizations [lem-pod-reindexing-evaluation-shift-composition]. Identify its derived functor with the ordinary completed-ring reindexing $F$ by an equality of functors (hence by the unique equality-induced isomorphism). Write $\mu^0$ for the transported ordinary tensor comparison and $\mu^c$ for T's completed tensor comparison. For constructible complete integral M and L, let $\eta_{M,L}$ be the actual reduction adjunction unit on their ordinary tensor, followed by reductionTensor and the inverse normalized integral tensor model. Then $F(\eta_{M,L});\mu^c_{M,L}=\mu^0_{M,L};\eta_{FM,FL}$. No assumption of perfection or completeness of the ordinary tensor is imposed. The augmentation η is supplied with an equality to its explicit adjunction-unit, reductionTensor and normalized Roos formula; this only names that fixed construction.

proof.text: Choose simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives. The quotient tensor augmentation, the ordinary tensor reindexing and the completed tensor reindexing send each homogeneous tensor to the same pair of reduced reindexed generators. Apply the Unit and quotient normalization laws for A, and Generators and Model for T. The RoosFst and RoosSnd laws identify both product coordinates, including the augmentation. Localize this equality and transport through the equality-induced identification of functors. The original representative normalizations ensure that the resulting maps are precisely the maps in the statement.

theorem podReindexing_tensor_augmentation_square
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (A : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g A)
    (hA : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g A)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g A T)
    (η : ∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (M L : podReindexingDerived l E W none),
      (podReindexCalculus l E W).integralClosed.tensor.obj (M, L) ⟶
        (integralCompletedTensor l E W).obj (M, L))
    (hη : η = fun W M L ↦
      (podReindexCalculus l E W).adjunction.unit.app
        (@MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj _ _
          (podReindexCalculus l E W).integralClosed.monoidal.toMonoidalCategoryStruct M L) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E W).map
        ((podReindexCalculus l E W).reductionTensor.hom.app (M, L)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorIntegralTensorModel l E W).inv.app (M, L))
    (c : PodReindexingCoherence.Comparison l E g none
      (podReindexCalculus l E X).integralClosed (podReindexCalculus l E Y).integralClosed
      (podReindexCalculus l E X).integralTensorModel
      (podReindexCalculus l E Y).integralTensorModel)
    (h : podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g none = podOrdinaryReindex l E g) :
    ∀ M L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      (podOrdinaryReindex l E g).map (η Y M.obj L.obj) ≫ (T.tensor M L).hom =
        (((eqToIso h).app
          ((podReindexCalculus l E Y).integralClosed.tensor.obj (M.obj, L.obj))).symm ≪≫
          c.tensor.app (M.obj, L.obj) ≪≫
          (podReindexCalculus l E X).integralClosed.tensor.mapIso
            (((eqToIso h).app M.obj).prod ((eqToIso h).app L.obj))).hom ≫
          η X ((podOrdinaryReindex l E g).obj M.obj)
            ((podOrdinaryReindex l E g).obj L.obj)
